note: Only transcript events cited by the manifest or by the frames of the positions file, written by the E1 extract script in the research tree (build plan section 4.1). verification.json corrections are applied: text and description carry the corrected values, corrected_text is kept when the verifier supplied one, and refuted events are listed in dropped instead of events. Transcript entry: {segment, video_id, transcript_sha256, verification_sha256}. Event: {segment, event_id, t, category, text, description, status: confirmed|corrected, corrected_text?, transcript_sha256}. Dropped entry: {segment, event_id, status: refuted, transcript_sha256}. t is decoded video seconds of the transcript's video.

events.text: Press [Mouse Button 2] to talk
events.description: A human NPC in a tan/brown leather jacket with a shearling collar, dark slicked-back hair, no hat and a pistol in his right hand enters beside the player at 558.867. From 559.000 the prompt 'Press [Mouse Button 2] to talk' shows and a translucent yellow rectangular marker hangs above his head (drawn high on screen); the marker stays up through at least 564.200. He remains on screen continuously; at 564.600 he stands beside an AFS soldier. From 565.2 to 567.0 he runs off to the left/distance with the yellow marker still above him. At 573.467 he stands with an AFS soldier facing the player, with a faint marker above. He is never targeted or named and the player does not talk to him; the footage does not show who he is.

An AFS soldier materialises next to another soldier: a translucent pale-blue ghost from 562.067, solid glowing blue 562.333-563.733, normal dark armour from 563.800 (spawn/teleport-in effect).
